title: One-handed sword
wikitext:
'''One Hand Swords''' is an [[item class]] of one-handed [[melee]] [[weapons]] that require [[strength]] and [[dexterity]] and have a {{c|mod|x% increased increased Accuracy Rating}} or {{c|mod|+x to Accuracy Rating}} [[implicit]] [[modifier]].

[[Maraketh weapon]]s with this item class have a {{c|mod|x% chance to Maim on Hit}} [[implicit]] instead. [[Experimented base type]] items with this item class have a {{c|mod|100% of Physical Damage from Hits with this Weapon is Converted to a random Element}} implicit instead.
